newsitem.title: GERMANY: German airports show 7.8 percent Sept cargo rise.
newsitem.headline: German airports show 7.8 percent Sept cargo rise.

text.p: The German air cargo market grew 7.8 percent to 168,701 tonnes of flown freight in September compared to 12 months previously, the German airports association ADV said.
Cargo flown from the country's 16 international airports from January-September rose 4.6 percent to 1,438,342 tonnes, according to the latest ADV monthly traffic report.
Exports increased 7.9 percent to 84,809 tonnes in September and have grown 5.2 percent to 730,681 tonnes over the first nine months of the year, it said.
Imports rose 7.8 percent to 79,177 tonnes in September and grew 4.5 percent to 669,382 tonnes from January-September, the report added.
Mail fell 13.1 percent to 26,001 tonnes in September and has declined 3.1 percent to 261,346 tonnes over the first nine months. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
